I am a academic researcher in Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Machine Learning, AI, Computation Linguistics, Geography and Digital Humanities. I am passionate about mathematics, human and social sciences, computers, and education. I really enjoy designing mathematical models for various phenomena (especially in human and social sciences), implementing numerical simulations, and creating data visualizations.
